name: Corsair Lighting Node (OpenRGB port)
description: Per-LED lighting of the two RGB headers of Corsair Lighting Node Core / Pro, Commander Pro, LS100 and LT100 kits, 1000D Obsidian and SPEC OMEGA RGB, as two channels of up to 204 LEDs. Adapted from OpenRGB (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. No effect configuration (stored by the device), brightness, fan or temperature command is sent; at shutdown the headers go back to hardware control (the device's stored effect). Protocol notes: docs/hardware/corsair-lighting-node.md.
